sections.title: Introduction
sections.extract: Effective management and optimisation of business processes are critical for organisations to remain competitive in today's dynamic and complex business environment. To achieve operational excellence, organisations employ various techniques and tools, one of which is the use of Business Process Visualisations (BPVs) [23]. sections.title: Graphical Perspective on Effectiveness of Visualisations
sections.extract: In this review, we adopt the definition of visualisation as the transformation and presentation of data in a visual form to facilitate conception and understanding [40]. This definition was chosen because BPV aims to facilitate communication, strategic thinking and decision-making [1]. This means that visualisation has to communicate information clearly and efficiently but should not be limited to traditional forms

sections.title: Methodological approach
sections.extract: This SLR followed a predefined protocol to ensure a transparent analysis of the literature. The selection process was carried out in several distinct phases (Figure 3), including the corresponding number of selected papers. sections.title: BPV frameworks used
sections.extract: In the selected articles, several frameworks were presented. The Visual Literacy Continuum distinguishes three different perspectives on BPV frameworks: visual thinking, visual learning, and visual communicating [85], which correspond with meanings for process design as a form of expression, a tool for thinking, and an aesthetic concept [8,9]. sections.title: Objectives of visualisations of processes
sections.extract: The effectiveness of process visualisations is gauged by the degree to which the visualisation achieves its intended objective. This underscores the importance of aligning the choice of visualisation with the specific goal in mind. Objectives for visualisations commonly fall into three categories: explanation, exploitation, and exploration [98]. Explanation focuses on displaying data for the sake of understanding

sections.title: Visualisation types used in BP visualisations
sections.extract: In Fig. 5, we categorised the process visualisations used in the articles read, according to the distinctive views in paragraphs 2 and 4.2. Task-centric visualisations are dominant when visualising business processes. BPMN and Petrinets, and all plug-ins and add-ons fall in this category. sections.extract: In this paragraph several tools will be introduced, mainly if they give more clarification or introduce new perspectives on ways to visualise business processes. sections.title: Case studies
sections.extract: We only found a limited number of publications to be classified as cases studies and there was hardly any focus on the effectiveness of the visualisations used. One study found that visualising data via compound timelines improved functionality (correctness and consistency), efficiency (completion time and user performance), and acceptance by the users [84], while others found positive effects on decision quality

sections.title: User Perspective on BPV Effectiveness
sections.extract: Several additional variables emerged from the articles read, which might have an impact on the effectiveness of process visualisations. All these variables lead back to the user, as not all users have the same characteristics. In this paragraph we will elaborate on these variables. sections.title: Visual Literacy and Visual Experience
sections.extract: Visual literacy refers to the competence of users to understand visualisations, based on education and experience in reading visuals. Various authors have noted differences in comprehension attributable to experience [9,30,66,78,82,102], so the reader's level of experience plays a crucial role in designing visualisations. sections.title: Culture, Media and Comprehension
sections.extract: Some authors reported cultural influences on the preference and comprehension of visualisations and its elements [27,34,43,56]. Colour coding was perceived differently in Asian compared to Western cultures [56]. Left-to-right flow direction was assumed to be preferred but no evidence was found [34]. sections.title: Gestalt and Cognitive Load Theory
sections.extract: For understanding the comprehension and effectiveness of visualisations, several authors refer to Gestalt theory [30,35,99] as it studies human perceptions. Gestalt theory deals with principles associated with how humans perceive whole figures instead of simpler, separate elements [99]. sections.title: Discussion and final remarks
sections.extract: This paper provided an extensive overview of the effectiveness of BPV from the perspective of data visualisation. Data visualisation and data storytelling are emerging fields for exploring and making data accessible. figures.title: Genres of narrative visualization proposed by Segel and Heer [86]
Review statistics with (a) number of articles per year, (b) number of articles per visualisation type, and (c) number of articles per category

narratives.en: Figure 1: Genres of narrative visualization proposed by Segel and Heer [86], depicting seven visual layouts: Magazine Style, Annotated Chart, Partitioned Poster, Flow Chart, Comic Strip, Slide Show, and Film/Video/Animation.
narratives.fr: Figure 1 : Genres de visualisation narrative proposés par Segel et Heer [86], présentant sept mises en page visuelles : style magazine, graphique annoté, affiche compartimentée, organigramme, bande dessinée, diaporama et film/vidéo/animation.
narratives.es: Figura 1: Géneros de visualización narrativa propuestos por Segel y Heer [86], que representan siete diseños visuales: estilo revista, gráfico anotado, póster particionado, diagrama de flujo, tira cómica, presentación de diapositivas y película/vídeo/animación.
narratives.ar: الشكل 1: أنماط التصور السردي المقترحة من قبل Segel وHeer [86]، وتعرض سبعة تخطيطات بصرية: نمط المجلة، المخطط المشروح، الملصق المقسم، مخطط التدفق، الشريط المصور، عرض الشرائح، والفيلم/الفيديو/الرسوم المتحركة.
narratives.zh: 图1：Segel和Heer [86] 提出的七种叙事可视化体裁：杂志风格、注释图表、分区海报、流程图、连环画、幻灯片演示以及电影/视频/动画。
narratives.ru: Рисунок 1: Жанры нарративной визуализации, предложенные Сегелем и Хиром [86], включающие семь визуальных макетов: журнальный стиль, аннотированная диаграмма, секционированный постер, блок-схема, комикс, слайд-шоу и фильм/видео/анимация.

narratives.en: Figure 2: Overview of the exclusion criteria (EC1: Non-English, EC2: Not peer-reviewed, EC3: Before 2009, EC4: <=4 pages, EC5: Non-full papers) and inclusion criteria (IC1-IC4) applied in the systematic literature review.
narratives.fr: Figure 2 : Vue d'ensemble des critères d'exclusion (EC1 : non-anglais, EC2 : non évalué par les pairs, EC3 : avant 2009, EC4 : <=4 pages, EC5 : articles incomplets) et des critères d'inclusion (IC1-IC4) appliqués dans la revue systématique.
narratives.es: Figura 2: Resumen de los criterios de exclusión (EC1: no inglés, EC2: sin revisión por pares, EC3: anterior a 2009, EC4: <=4 páginas, EC5: artículos no completos) y de inclusión (IC1-IC4) aplicados en la revisión sistemática.
narratives.ar: الشكل 2: نظرة عامة على معايير الاستبعاد (EC1: غير الإنجليزية، EC2: غير محكمة، EC3: قبل 2009، EC4: <=4 صفحات، EC5: أوراق غير كاملة) ومعايير التضمين (IC1-IC4) المطبقة في المراجعة المنهجية للأدبيات.
narratives.zh: 图2：系统性文献综述中应用的排除标准（EC1：非英文，EC2：非同行评审，EC3：2009年以前，EC4：<=4页，EC5：非全文论文）与纳入标准（IC1-IC4）概览。
narratives.ru: Рисунок 2: Обзор критериев исключения (EC1: не на английском языке, EC2: без рецензирования, EC3: до 2009 года, EC4: <=4 страниц, EC5: неполные статьи) и критериев включения (IC1-IC4), примененных в систематическом обзоре.

narratives.en: Figure 3: Results of applying the exclusion (EC1-EC5) and inclusion (IC1-IC4) criteria across five databases (IEEE, ACM, SpringerLink, ScienceDirect, Google Scholar), reducing 708 initial hits to 252 papers before full-text reading (where 30 out-of-scope papers were subsequently removed, leaving 222 primary studies).
narratives.fr: Figure 3 : Résultats de l'application des critères d'exclusion (EC1-EC5) et d'inclusion (IC1-IC4) sur cinq bases de données (IEEE, ACM, SpringerLink, ScienceDirect, Google Scholar), réduisant 708 résultats initiaux à 252 articles avant lecture intégrale (222 études primaires finales).
narratives.es: Figura 3: Resultados tras aplicar los criterios de exclusión (EC1-EC5) e inclusión (IC1-IC4) en cinco bases de datos (IEEE, ACM, SpringerLink, ScienceDirect, Google Scholar), reduciendo 708 resultados iniciales a 252 artículos antes de la lectura completa (222 estudios primarios finales).
narratives.ar: الشكل 3: نتائج تطبيق معايير الاستبعاد (EC1-EC5) والتضمين (IC1-IC4) عبر خمس قواعد بيانات (IEEE وACM وSpringerLink وScienceDirect وGoogle Scholar)، مما قلص 708 نتيجة أولية إلى 252 ورقة قبل القراءة الكاملة (222 دراسة أساسية نهائية).
narratives.zh: 图3：在五个数据库（IEEE、ACM、SpringerLink、ScienceDirect、Google Scholar）中应用排除标准（EC1-EC5）和纳入标准（IC1-IC4）后的筛选结果，将708篇初始文献缩减至252篇（全文阅读剔除30篇超出范围文献后最终保留222篇初级研究）。
narratives.ru: Рисунок 3: Результаты применения критериев исключения (EC1-EC5) и включения (IC1-IC4) по пяти базам данных (IEEE, ACM, SpringerLink, ScienceDirect, Google Scholar), сократившие 708 исходных записей до 252 статей перед чтением полного текста (222 итоговых первичных исследования).

narratives.en: Figure 4: Review statistics across the included corpus showing (a) number of articles published per year, (b) distribution of articles per visualisation type, and (c) distribution of articles per thematic category.
narratives.fr: Figure 4 : Statistiques de la revue sur le corpus inclus montrant (a) le nombre d'articles publiés par an, (b) la répartition des articles par type de visualisation et (c) la répartition des articles par catégorie thématique.
narratives.es: Figura 4: Estadísticas de la revisión sobre el corpus incluido que muestran (a) número de artículos por año, (b) distribución de artículos por tipo de visualización y (c) distribución de artículos por categoría temática.
narratives.ar: الشكل 4: إحصاءات المراجعة عبر مجموعة الدراسات المشمولة وتوضح (أ) عدد المقالات المنشورة سنوياً، (ب) توزيع المقالات حسب نوع التصور البصري، و(ج) توزيع المقالات حسب الفئة الموضوعية.
narratives.zh: 图4：纳入文献的统计概览，展示（a）每年发表的文章数量、（b）按可视化类型划分的文章分布，以及（c）按主题类别划分的文章分布。
narratives.ru: Рисунок 4: Статистика обзора по включенному корпусу статей: (a) количество статей по годам публикации, (b) распределение статей по типам визуализации и (c) распределение статей по тематическим категориям.

narratives.en: Figure 5: Categorisation of the reviewed papers across Data-centric, Task-centric (dominated by BPMN and Petri nets), and Internal representation perspectives on business process visualisations.
narratives.fr: Figure 5 : Catégorisation des articles examinés selon les perspectives centrée sur les données, centrée sur les tâches (dominée par BPMN et les réseaux de Petri) et de représentation interne des visualisations de processus métier.
narratives.es: Figura 5: Categorización de los artículos revisados según las perspectivas centrada en datos, centrada en tareas (dominada por BPMN y redes de Petri) y de representación interna de las visualizaciones de procesos de negocio.
narratives.ar: الشكل 5: تصنيف الأوراق البحثية المراجعة عبر المنظورات المرتكزة على البيانات، والمرتكزة على المهام (تسيطر عليها BPMN وشبكات بتري)، ومنظور التمثيل الداخلي لتصورات عمليات الأعمال.
narratives.zh: 图5：按以数据为中心、以任务为中心（以BPMN和Petri网为主）以及内部表示三种视角对综述文献中使用的业务流程可视化进行分类。
narratives.ru: Рисунок 5: Категоризация рассмотренных статей по дата-центричному, задачно-центричному (с преобладанием BPMN и сетей Петри) и внутреннему представлениям визуализаций бизнес-процессов.

narratives.en: Figure 6: Visual patterns to facilitate the understanding of business processes (adapted from [60]), illustrating graphical encoding patterns for process structure and state.
narratives.fr: Figure 6 : Modèles visuels facilitant la compréhension des processus métier (adapté de [60]), illustrant des schémas d'encodage graphique pour la structure et l'état des processus.
narratives.es: Figura 6: Patrones visuales para facilitar la comprensión de los procesos de negocio (adaptado de [60]), ilustrando esquemas de codificación gráfica para la estructura y el estado del proceso.
narratives.ar: الشكل 6: أنماط بصرية لتسهيل فهم عمليات الأعمال (مقتبس من [60])، توضح أنماط الترميز الرسومي لبنية العملية وحالتها.
narratives.zh: 图6：促进业务流程理解的视觉模式（改编自[60]），展示了用于表示流程结构与状态的图形编码模式。
narratives.ru: Рисунок 6: Визуальные паттерны для облегчения понимания бизнес-процессов (адаптировано из [60]), иллюстрирующие схемы графического кодирования структуры и состояния процесса.
